_description: Single source of truth for repo-hygiene rules. Read by pre-commit hook, CI workflows, and skills (morning-sync, weekly prep). Do not duplicate values elsewhere — if you need a new rule, add it here.
_allowed_root_dirs_note: Core directories listed first. 'data-science' and 'engineering' are kept allowed at root for users who enable those add-ons (move from add-ons/X to root X). Default install ships them under add-ons/.

project_categories._description: Customize this for your team. Each category = a folder under projects/ + a section header in weekly output. The weekly skill lints that every project listed under a section's header belongs to that category's path. Remove categories that don't apply; add your own.

freshness_sla_days._description: Max days a project README 'Last updated' can lag before morning-sync flags it. Matched by phase value (case-insensitive prefix). Values are soft limits — flag as warning, not error.

phase_required_files._description: When a project's phase is set to X, these files must exist. Pre-commit checks on README phase change; morning-sync flags drift. The special token `_rfc_any` means rfc-frontend.md OR rfc-backend.md.

strategy_cadence_days._description: How often strategy files should show activity. Used by morning-sync to surface hygiene items.

readme_required_fields._description: Every project README.md (except _template/ and _example/) must contain a Status block with these fields. Enforced by pre-commit.

channel_roles._description: Team customizes this in config/morning-sync.md. Role values: 'pm' (always surface), 'eng' (only product-keyword matches), 'ds' (only product-relevant), 'monitor' (flag as context only).

product_keywords_for_eng_ds_filter._description: Customize for your product. Used by morning-sync to decide whether an eng-role or ds-role channel message is worth surfacing to the PM.

experiment_decision_keywords._description: Classify experiment status language in meeting transcripts. Morning-sync must not write 'decided' or 'winner' unless an explicit confirmed-tier keyword is present.
